comparison.objective: Restock two cartons behind existing cartons in a spring-pusher lane.
comparison.physical_skill: Holding a spring-loaded pusher while placing cartons in constrained order.
comparison.success_condition: All cartons remain correctly ordered in the lane and the pusher closes the row without overflight or displacement violations.
comparison.reason: Tests simultaneous spring restraint and ordered placement of boxes, not precision impact tooling or post-fracture debris containment.
